input.zh: 你给模型的开头，比如“今天天气真”。
input.en: The opening you give the model, e.g. “Today the weather is really”.

tokenizer.zh: 把文字切成小块（词元），每块换成一个编号。
tokenizer.en: Cuts text into small pieces (tokens) and replaces each piece with an ID.

embed.zh: 按编号查出一串数字（向量），代表这个词的“意思”。
embed.en: Looks up a list of numbers (a vector) by ID, representing the word’s “meaning”.

pos.zh: 告诉模型每个词排在第几个。
pos.en: Tells the model where each word sits in the order.

blocks.zh: 把每个词的向量反复加工，让它越来越“懂上下文”。
blocks.en: Processes each word’s vector over and over so it “understands the context” better and better.

lmhead.zh: 把最后的向量变成“词表里每个词一个分数”。
lmhead.en: Turns the final vector into “one score for every word in the vocabulary”.

logits.zh: 每个候选词一个原始分数，可正可负，还不是概率。
logits.en: One raw score per candidate word, positive or negative, not yet a probability.

prob.zh: 把分数换算成加起来等于 100% 的概率。
prob.en: Turns scores into probabilities that add up to 100%.

sample.zh: 按概率抽一个词，接回输入末尾。
sample.en: Draws one word by probability and appends it to the end of the input.

attn.zh: 词和词之间互相“看一眼”，交换信息。
attn.en: Words “take a look” at each other and exchange information.

addnorm.zh: 保留原来的信息（残差），再把数字调到稳定的尺度（归一化）。
addnorm.en: Keeps the original information (residual), then brings the numbers to a stable scale (normalization).

ffn.zh: 每个词各自“消化思考”，调用学到的知识。
ffn.en: Each word “digests and thinks” on its own, drawing on learned knowledge.

xin.zh: 每个词一条向量（来自上一层，或来自词嵌入+位置）。
xin.en: One vector per word (from the previous layer, or from embedding + position).

wq.zh: 把词向量变成“提问卡”：我想找什么样的词？
wq.en: Turns a word vector into a “query card”: what kind of word am I looking for?

wk.zh: 把词向量变成“标签卡”：我是什么样的词，供别人匹配。
wk.en: Turns a word vector into a “key card”: what kind of word I am, for others to match against.

wv.zh: 把词向量变成“内容卡”：别人关注我时，我交出去的信息。
wv.en: Turns a word vector into a “value card”: the information I hand over when others attend to me.

q.zh: 每个词的问题：我在找什么？
q.en: Each word’s question: what am I looking for?

k.zh: 每个词的标签：我是什么？
k.en: Each word’s label: what am I?

v.en: The information each word can provide.

score.zh: 提问卡和标签卡对一对，算匹配分。
score.en: Match query cards against key cards to compute match scores.

mask.zh: 只许看自己和前面的词，不许偷看后面。
mask.en: Only itself and earlier words may be seen; no peeking at later ones.

asoft.zh: 把匹配分变成加起来 100% 的关注比例。
asoft.en: Turns match scores into attention weights that add up to 100%.

mix.zh: 按关注比例，把大家的内容卡混成一张新卡。
mix.en: Mixes everyone’s value cards into one new card according to the attention weights.

heads.zh: 好几组注意力同时进行，结果首尾拼在一起。
heads.en: Several attention groups run at once and their results are joined end to end.

wo.zh: 把拼起来的多头结果整合，变回原来的长度。
wo.en: Merges the concatenated multi-head results and brings them back to the original length.

w1.zh: 把向量放大成更长的一串（常见约 4 倍长）。
w1.en: Expands the vector into a longer list (typically about 4× as long).

act.zh: 决定哪些探测器“亮”、哪些“灭”。
act.en: Decides which detectors are “on” and which are “off”.

w2.zh: 把亮着的特征汇总，压回原来的长度。
w2.en: Gathers the active features and compresses them back to the original length.

residual.zh: 把工序的结果加到原向量上，而不是替换。
residual.en: Adds the step’s result to the original vector instead of replacing it.

norm.zh: 把一串数字调整到统一的尺度。
norm.en: Brings a list of numbers to a common scale.

data.zh: 训练用的练习题：从文本里截一段，猜紧接着的词。
data.en: The training exercises: cut a passage from text and guess the word that follows.

loss.zh: 一个数字：这道题猜得有多差。
loss.en: A single number: how badly this question was guessed.

backprop.zh: 算出每个参数该往哪调，然后挪一小步。
backprop.en: Works out which way each parameter should move, then takes a small step.

user.zh: 整个系统的起点：用大白话说出你想要什么。
user.en: Where the whole system starts: saying what you want in plain words.

app.zh: 把大模型包装成“能动手干活”的程序：规划、调用工具、记忆、循环、权限。
app.en: Wraps the LLM into a program that “gets things done”: planning, tool calls, memory, loops, permissions.

llm.zh: Agent 的“大脑”：读一段文字，一个词一个词地写出接下来的内容。
llm.en: The agent’s “brain”: reads a passage of text and writes what comes next, one token at a time.

mmenc.zh: 大模型的“眼睛、耳朵和画笔”：把图片声音变成 token，或把 token 变回图片声音。
mmenc.en: The LLM’s “eyes, ears and paintbrush”: turning images and sounds into tokens, or tokens back into images and sounds.

trainsys.zh: 模型的本事从哪来：预训练 → 指令微调 → 偏好对齐 → 推理强化学习。
trainsys.en: Where the model’s skills come from: pretraining → instruction tuning → preference alignment → reasoning RL.

infra.zh: 让模型真的跑起来：GPU 集群、推理服务、KV 缓存、批处理、量化。
infra.en: Makes the model actually run: GPU clusters, inference serving, KV cache, batching, quantization.

loop.zh: 观察 → 思考 → 行动（调用工具）→ 看结果 → 再思考……直到完成。
loop.en: Observe → think → act (call a tool) → check the result → think again… until done.

goal.zh: 任务从这里开始：你想要的结果。
goal.en: Where the task begins: the result you want.

ctx.zh: 模型这一圈能“看到”的全部文字。
ctx.en: All the text the model can “see” this round.

think.zh: 大模型读完上下文，决定：直接回答，还是调用哪个工具、传什么参数。
think.en: The LLM reads the context and decides: answer directly, or call which tool with which arguments.

tools.zh: 模型输出一段结构化“调用请求”（如 JSON），由外部程序真正执行。
tools.en: The model outputs a structured “call request” (e.g. JSON) that an external program actually executes.

schema.zh: 告诉模型“有哪些工具、干什么用、参数怎么填”的文字。
schema.en: Text that tells the model “which tools exist, what they’re for, and how to fill in the arguments”.

toolres.zh: 程序执行工具后的返回值（或报错），作为文字追加进上下文。
toolres.en: The return value (or error) after the program runs the tool, appended to the context as text.

answer.zh: 模型判断目标已达成，用自然语言汇报。
answer.en: The model judges the goal achieved and reports in natural language.

plan.zh: 把大任务拆成小步骤，必要时根据结果改计划。
plan.en: Breaks a big task into small steps and revises the plan based on results if needed.

memory.zh: 短期记忆是上下文；长期记忆存在外部，需要时检索出来放进上下文。
memory.en: Short-term memory is the context; long-term memory lives outside and is retrieved into the context when needed.

chunk.zh: 把长文档切成几百字左右的小段。
chunk.en: Splits long documents into short passages of a few hundred words.

vemb.zh: 把一段文字变成一串数字（向量），意思相近的文字向量也相近。
vemb.en: Turns a passage into a list of numbers (a vector); texts with similar meanings get similar vectors.

vecdb.zh: 专门存大量向量、并能快速找出“最相近的几个”的数据库。
vecdb.en: A database specialized in storing lots of vectors and quickly finding “the few nearest”.

retr.zh: 拿问题的向量去比，取出最相似的 k 块原文放进上下文。
retr.en: Compares the question’s vector and puts the k most similar chunks of original text into the context.

multi.zh: 多个分工不同的 Agent 互相传递任务和结果。
multi.en: Several agents with different roles pass tasks and results to each other.

orch.en: Splits the task, assigns the parts, gathers the results.

worker.zh: 专注完成一个子任务，比如查资料或写代码。
worker.en: Focuses on completing one subtask, such as research or writing code.

critic.zh: 检查结果对不对、全不全，不对就打回。
critic.en: Checks whether the result is correct and complete, and sends it back if not.

mcp.zh: 给工具做一个“统一插座”：工具方实现一次，各种 AI 应用都能接。
mcp.en: A “universal socket” for tools: the tool provider implements it once and every AI app can connect.

mcphost.zh: 用户直接使用的 AI 应用，里面装着大模型调用逻辑和 MCP 客户端。
mcphost.en: The AI app the user uses directly, containing the LLM-calling logic and the MCP client.

mcpclient.zh: 宿主里负责“说协议”的那部分。
mcpclient.en: The part of the host that “speaks the protocol”.

mcpserver.zh: 工具方提供的“插座”，把日历、天气、文件等能力按协议暴露出来。
mcpserver.en: The “socket” provided by the tool provider, exposing capabilities like calendars, weather and files via the protocol.

guard.zh: 给 Agent 的“手脚”装上闸门：最小权限、写操作确认、防提示注入。
guard.en: Puts gates on the agent’s “hands and feet”: least privilege, confirmation for write actions, defence against prompt injection.

inject.zh: 网页、邮件、文档里藏着“给 AI 的指令”，试图劫持 Agent。
inject.en: “Instructions to the AI” hidden in web pages, emails or documents that try to hijack the agent.

perm.zh: 只给完成任务所需的最少权限，重要操作让人点头。
perm.en: Grant only the minimum permissions the task needs, and have a person approve important actions.

evalag.zh: 怎么知道 Agent 好不好：完成率、成本、速度、安全性一起看。
evalag.en: How to tell whether an agent is good: look at completion rate, cost, speed and safety together.

ctxwin.zh: 模型一次最多能“看到”的 token 数量。
ctxwin.en: The maximum number of tokens the model can “see” at once.

moe.zh: 把一个大前馈网络换成很多个“小专家”，每个 token 只交给其中少数几个。
moe.en: Replaces one big feed-forward network with many “small experts”, sending each token to only a few of them.

router.zh: 给每个专家打分，决定这个 token 交给谁。
router.en: Scores each expert and decides who gets this token.

expert.zh: 一个独立的小前馈网络（放大—开关—压回）。
expert.en: An independent small feed-forward network (expand – switch – compress).

topk.zh: 只保留分数最高的 k 个专家，其余直接跳过。
topk.en: Keeps only the k highest-scoring experts and skips the rest entirely.

lbloss.zh: 训练时额外“扣分”：如果 token 都挤到少数几个专家，就罚。
lbloss.en: An extra training “penalty”: if tokens crowd onto a few experts, it’s penalized.

sparse.zh: 每个 token 只算少数专家，但所有专家都得随时待命在显存里。
sparse.en: Each token only computes a few experts, but all experts have to stand by in GPU memory.

mha.zh: 每个头都有自己的 Q、K、V。
mha.en: Every head has its own Q, K and V.

gqa.zh: 多个 Q 头共用一组 K、V，KV 缓存成倍缩小。
gqa.en: Several Q heads share one set of K and V, shrinking the KV cache several-fold.

longctx.zh: 让模型读得更长：位置编码外推、稀疏/滑动窗口注意力、长文本继续训练等。
longctx.en: Letting the model read further: position-encoding extrapolation, sparse/sliding-window attention, long-text continued training and more.

distill.zh: 让小模型（学生）模仿大模型（老师）的输出。
distill.en: Has a small model (the student) imitate the outputs of a large model (the teacher).

lora.zh: 不改原模型，只在旁边加两张很“瘦”的小表来学新本事。
lora.en: Leaves the original model untouched and adds two very “thin” small tables alongside to learn new skills.

quant.zh: 把参数从高精度数字换成低精度（位数更少）来存和算。
quant.en: Stores and computes parameters with lower-precision numbers (fewer bits) instead of high-precision ones.

serve.zh: 把模型部署在 GPU 上，接收请求、调度计算、流式返回结果。
serve.en: Deploys the model on GPUs, receives requests, schedules computation and streams back results.

batch.zh: 把很多用户的请求拼在一起算，一次读权重服务一大批人。
batch.en: Computes many users’ requests together, so one read of the weights serves a large batch of people.

kvcache.zh: 把前文每个 token 的 K、V 存起来，生成新 token 时直接复用。
kvcache.en: Stores the K and V of every earlier token and reuses them directly when generating a new token.

specdec.zh: 让小“草稿模型”先猜几个 token，大模型一次性验收。
specdec.en: A small “draft model” guesses a few tokens first, and the big model checks them all at once.

mmhub.zh: 不管文字、图片、声音、视频，最后都变成一串向量排队进模型。
mmhub.en: Whether text, images, sound or video, it all ends up as a sequence of vectors queued into the model.

vit.zh: 把图片切成小块，用 Transformer 加工成一串“视觉 token”。
vit.en: Cuts an image into small patches and processes them with a Transformer into a sequence of “visual tokens”.

patch.zh: 把图片切成方块，每块变成一条向量。
patch.en: Cuts the image into squares and turns each into a vector.

audenc.zh: 把声音变成频谱再切片，加工成一串“音频 token”。
audenc.en: Turns sound into a spectrogram, slices it, and processes it into a sequence of “audio tokens”.

mel.zh: 把一小段声音分解成“由哪些频率组成”，随时间排开。
mel.en: Breaks a short stretch of sound down into “which frequencies it’s made of”, laid out over time.

clip.zh: 让配对的“图”和“文”向量靠近，不配对的远离。
clip.en: Pulls the vectors of matching “image” and “text” pairs together and pushes non-matching ones apart.

txtenc.zh: 把一句描述变成一条向量，和图片向量放在同一空间。
txtenc.en: Turns a caption into a vector in the same space as the image vectors.

projector.zh: 把视觉/音频向量“翻译”成大模型能读的词向量格式。
projector.en: “Translates” visual/audio vectors into the word-vector format the LLM can read.

mllm.zh: 视觉/音频 token 和文字 token 排在一起，由大模型统一理解。
mllm.en: Visual/audio tokens are lined up with text tokens and understood together by the LLM.

gtext.zh: 一个 token 一个 token 地接龙写出文字。
gtext.en: Writes text token by token, like a word chain.

gimg.zh: 从一团噪声出发，在文字引导下一步步“雕”出一张图。
gimg.en: Starting from a cloud of noise, “sculpts” an image step by step under the guidance of text.

denoise.zh: 看着带噪图、时间步和文字条件，预测“噪声是什么”。
denoise.en: Looks at the noisy image, the time step and the text condition, and predicts “what the noise is”.

vae.zh: 先把图片压缩成小得多的“潜空间”，在那里扩散，最后再解压回像素。
vae.en: First compresses the image into a much smaller “latent space”, diffuses there, and finally decompresses back to pixels.

tcond.zh: 把提示词变成向量，注入去噪网络；引导强度决定多“听话”。
tcond.en: Turns the prompt into vectors injected into the denoising network; the guidance strength decides how “obedient” it is.

gaud.zh: 把声音变成“声学 token”或频谱，用自回归或扩散生成，再还原成波形。
gaud.en: Turns sound into “acoustic tokens” or a spectrogram, generates it autoregressively or by diffusion, then restores the waveform.

codec.zh: 把波形压成一串离散 token，也能解码回来。
codec.en: Compresses a waveform into a sequence of discrete tokens that can be decoded back.

acoustic.zh: 根据文字（和参考音色）写出声学 token 或频谱。
acoustic.en: Writes acoustic tokens or a spectrogram from text (and a reference voice).

vocoder.zh: 把频谱或声学 token 还原成可以播放的波形。
vocoder.en: Turns a spectrogram or acoustic tokens back into a playable waveform.

gvid.zh: 在“时空潜空间”里做扩散，让每一帧都好看、帧与帧之间连贯。
gvid.en: Diffuses in a “spatio-temporal latent space” so every frame looks good and consecutive frames are coherent.

stlatent.zh: 在长宽和时间三个方向同时压缩视频。
stlatent.en: Compresses video along width, height and time at once.

dit.zh: 用 Transformer 做去噪网络，让每个时空块都能“注意”其他帧。
dit.en: Uses a Transformer as the denoising network so every space-time patch can “attend to” other frames.

tempcons.zh: 同一个东西在不同帧要长得一样、动得合理。
tempcons.en: The same thing must look the same across frames and move plausibly.

g3d.zh: 先选一种 3D 表示，再借助 2D 生成能力或 3D 数据“雕”出立体物体。
g3d.en: First choose a 3D representation, then “sculpt” a solid object with the help of 2D generation abilities or 3D data.

rep3d.zh: 用什么格式描述一个立体物体。
rep3d.en: What format describes a solid object.

mview.zh: 一次生成同一个物体的多个一致视角。
mview.en: Generates several consistent views of the same object in one go.

recon.zh: 从多张视角图拼出 3D 模型。
recon.en: Assembles a 3D model from several view images.

sds.zh: 用 2D 图像扩散模型当“评委”，一步步把 3D 物体“改像”。
sds.en: Uses a 2D image diffusion model as a “judge” to make a 3D object “look right” step by step.

nnet.zh: 一个有大量“旋钮”的数学函数：输入数字，输出数字，旋钮靠数据自动拧好。
nnet.en: A mathematical function with lots of “knobs”: numbers in, numbers out, with the knobs tuned automatically from data.

neuron.zh: 加权求和 + 激活：最小的计算单元。
neuron.en: Weighted sum + activation: the smallest unit of computation.

arch.zh: 神经元怎么连：不同连法适合不同数据。
arch.en: How neurons are connected: different wiring suits different data.

ssl.zh: 从数据本身造题目，不需要人工标注。
ssl.en: Makes exercises from the data itself, without human labelling.

pretrain.zh: 在海量文本（和代码等）上做“猜下一个词”，打下语言和知识的地基。
pretrain.en: “Guess the next word” on huge amounts of text (and code, etc.), laying the foundation of language and knowledge.

sft.zh: 用人写的“问题 → 优质回答”示范，教模型按指令、按对话格式回答。
sft.en: Uses human-written “question → high-quality answer” demonstrations to teach the model to follow instructions and answer in dialogue format.

pref.zh: 让人比较“哪个回答更好”，用这些偏好去调整模型。
pref.en: Has people compare “which answer is better” and uses those preferences to adjust the model.

rlvr.zh: 对数学、代码这类能自动判对错的题，让模型多试几次，对了就奖励。
rlvr.en: For problems like maths and code where right and wrong can be checked automatically, let the model try several times and reward it when it’s right.

rl.zh: 在“试错 + 奖励”中学会做决策，目标是长期累计奖励最大。
rl.en: Learns to make decisions through “trial and error + reward”, aiming to maximize the long-term cumulative reward.

qlearn.zh: 给每个“状态+动作”估一个长期得分 Q，走一步修正一次。
qlearn.en: Estimates a long-term score Q for every “state + action” and corrects it after each step.

rm.zh: 学会模仿人类偏好，给回答打分。
rm.en: Learns to imitate human preferences and scores answers.

kl.en: A brake that says “don’t stray too far from the original model”.

dpo.zh: 不训练单独的奖励模型，直接用“A 比 B 好”的数据调整模型。
dpo.en: Adjusts the model directly with “A is better than B” data, without training a separate reward model.

compute.zh: 训练的两大燃料：海量高质量数据 + 大规模 GPU 集群。
compute.en: The two fuels of training: huge amounts of high-quality data + large GPU clusters.

nNeuron.zh: 最小的零件：把几个输入各乘一个权重、加起来、再加偏置，最后过一个“开关”（激活函数）。
nNeuron.en: The smallest part: multiply each input by a weight, add them up, add a bias, then pass the sum through a “switch” (the activation function).

nLayer.zh: 很多个神经元并排，同时看同一组输入，各自给出一个数。
nLayer.en: Many neurons side by side, all looking at the same inputs, each giving one number.

nNet.zh: 很多层叠起来：前一层的输出是后一层的输入。
nNet.en: Many layers stacked: each layer’s output is the next layer’s input.

nFwd.zh: 把输入从第一层一路算到输出，得到模型的答案（预测）。
nFwd.en: Run the input through every layer to the output, giving the model’s answer (prediction).

nLoss.zh: 一个数，衡量“模型的答案离标准答案有多远”。越小越好。
nLoss.en: One number measuring “how far the model’s answer is from the right answer”. Smaller is better.

nBp.zh: 从损失出发往回走，用链式法则算出每个参数的梯度：“它变一点，损失变多少”。
nBp.en: Walk back from the loss and use the chain rule to get every parameter’s gradient: “if it changes a little, how much does the loss change”.

nUpd.zh: 每个参数朝梯度的反方向挪一小步：新值 = 旧值 − 学习率 × 梯度。
nUpd.en: Every parameter takes a small step against its gradient: new = old − learning rate × gradient.

nAct.zh: 加权求和之后的“开关”或“弯折”：把直线变成折线或曲线。
nAct.en: The “switch” or “bend” after the weighted sum: turns straight lines into kinks and curves.

nCg.zh: 把计算拆成一个个小节点连成图；求导时沿图往回，把每段的局部导数相乘。
nCg.en: Break the computation into small nodes joined in a graph; to differentiate, walk the graph backwards multiplying each local derivative.

nOpt.zh: 决定“拿到梯度后具体怎么走”的规则。
nOpt.en: The rule for “exactly how to step once you have the gradient”.

nLr.zh: 每一步“迈多大”。最重要的超参数之一。
nLr.en: How big each step is. One of the most important hyperparameters.

nBatch.zh: 每次只拿一小批样本算梯度、更新一次；全部数据用过一遍叫一轮。
nBatch.en: Each update uses only a small batch of examples; one pass over all the data is an epoch.

nSplit.zh: 把数据分三份：一份用来学，一份用来调设置和判断何时停，一份留到最后只考一次。
nSplit.en: Split data three ways: one to learn from, one to tune settings and decide when to stop, one kept for a single final exam.

nInit.zh: 训练开始前给所有权重随机赋的小数字。
nInit.en: The small random numbers given to every weight before training starts.

nNorm.zh: 把一层的数字拉回统一大小，免得越算越大或越小。
nNorm.en: Pull a layer’s numbers back to a standard size so they don’t keep growing or shrinking.

nReg.zh: 各种“别死记硬背”的手段：L2 权重衰减、dropout、早停、更多数据。
nReg.en: Ways to discourage rote memorization: L2 weight decay, dropout, early stopping, more data.

nDrop.zh: 训练时每一步随机“关掉”一部分神经元（比如一半），使用时全部打开。
nDrop.en: During training, randomly switch off part of the neurons (say half) at every step; at use time all are on.

nCnn.zh: 用同一个小“滤镜”（卷积核）在图上滑动找图案，层层组合：边缘 → 纹理 → 部件 → 物体。
nCnn.en: Slide one small “filter” (kernel) across the image to find patterns, combining layer by layer: edges → textures → parts → objects.

nRnn.zh: 一个词一个词地读，每读一个词就更新一次“记忆”（隐藏状态），再带着记忆读下一个。
nRnn.en: Reads one word at a time, updating a “memory” (hidden state) after each, then carries it to the next word.

nLstm.zh: 带“门”的 RNN：用几个开关决定记忆里什么该保留、什么该忘、什么该输出。
nLstm.en: An RNN with “gates”: switches decide what to keep in memory, what to forget and what to output.

nEmb.zh: 每个词对应一串数字（向量）；意思相近的词，向量也靠得近。
nEmb.en: Each word gets a list of numbers (a vector); words with similar meanings get nearby vectors.

uHub.zh: 同一个 Agent（大模型 + 工具 + 循环），可以有很多种用法；差别只在四件事。
uHub.en: The same agent (LLM + tools + loop) can be used in many ways; they differ in only four things.

uWith.zh: 你在旁边：它每做一步你都看得见，关键步骤要你点头。
uWith.en: You sit beside it: you see every step, and key steps wait for your OK.

uSolo.zh: 你把任务交出去，它在隔离环境里独立跑完，你事后看结果。
uSolo.en: You hand the task over, it runs to the end in an isolated environment, and you review the result afterwards.

uKit.zh: 不换模型，也能让它多会几样：接工具、连 MCP 服务器、装 Skills。
uKit.en: Without changing the model you can teach it more: add tools, connect MCP servers, install skills.

uWell.zh: 同一个 Agent，交代得清不清楚、上下文干不干净，结果差很多。
uWell.en: With the same agent, results differ a lot depending on how clearly you brief it and how clean its context is.

uChat.zh: 在网页或 App 里一问一答；能力最小、最安全，也是最常见的用法。
uChat.en: Ask and answer in a web page or app; the least access, the safest, and the most common use.

uIde.zh: 住在代码编辑器里：能读你的项目、改文件、跑命令，你看着改动一项项确认。
uIde.en: Lives in your code editor: reads your project, edits files, runs commands, while you review and accept each change.

uCli.zh: 在终端里跑的编程 Agent：能读写文件、执行命令、用 git；靠“权限档位”控制它能自己做多少。
uCli.en: A coding agent in the terminal: reads and writes files, runs commands, uses git; a permission level decides how much it does on its own.

uCua.zh: 像人一样操作网页或电脑：看截图 / 页面结构，然后点击、输入、滚动。
uCua.en: Operates web pages or a computer like a person: looks at screenshots / the page structure, then clicks, types, scrolls.

uBg.zh: 把任务交给云端：它在一份代码副本里独立干活，最后交回一个分支或合并请求（PR）。
uBg.en: Hand the task to the cloud: it works alone on a copy of the code and hands back a branch or a pull request (PR).

uRoutine.zh: 不用你开口：到点了或者某件事发生时，Agent 按固定的提示词自动跑一遍。
uRoutine.en: No need to ask: on a schedule or when something happens, the agent runs a fixed prompt automatically.

uMulti.zh: 一个“协调者”把大任务拆开，派给几个“执行者”并行做，再由“审查者”把关、汇总。
uMulti.en: A coordinator splits a big task, sends parts to several workers in parallel, and a reviewer checks and merges the results.

uTool.zh: 一个工具 = 名字 + 用途说明 + 参数格式；模型按说明书输出 JSON，程序去真正执行。
uTool.en: A tool = a name + what it is for + a parameter format; the model writes JSON per the manual and the program actually runs it.

uMcp.zh: 2024 年底提出的开放协议：让任何 AI 应用用同一种方式接上别人做好的工具和数据。
uMcp.en: An open protocol proposed in late 2024: any AI app can plug in tools and data that others have built, in one standard way.

uSkill.zh: 一个文件夹：一份“怎么做某类事”的说明（加上可选的脚本和模板）；平时只露出名字和一句话简介。
uSkill.en: A folder: instructions for “how to do a kind of task” (plus optional scripts and templates); normally only its name and one-line description are shown.

uPrompt.zh: 好的委托说清四件事：目标、背景、不许做什么、怎样算完成。
uPrompt.en: A good brief states four things: the goal, the background, what not to do, and what counts as done.

uCtx.zh: 上下文是一张大小有限的工作台：放相关的，拿走无关的。
uCtx.en: The context is a workbench of limited size: put on what is relevant, take off what is not.

kLim.zh: 当 x 越来越靠近 a 时，f(x) 越来越靠近哪个数。
kLim.en: The value f(x) gets arbitrarily close to as x gets close to a.

kDer.zh: 函数在一点的瞬时变化率：输入动一点点，输出大约动多少倍。
kDer.en: The instantaneous rate of change: if the input moves a little, how many times as much the output moves.

kChain.zh: 复合函数的导数等于各层导数相乘：(f\circ g)'(x)=f'(g(x))\,g'(x)。
kChain.en: The derivative of a composition is the product of the layers’ derivatives: (f\circ g)'(x)=f'(g(x))\,g'(x).

kGrad.zh: 多个输入时，对每个输入分别求导（其余不动），排成一个向量 \nabla f。
kGrad.en: With several inputs, differentiate with respect to each one (holding the rest fixed) and stack the results into a vector \nabla f.

kInt.zh: 把很多很小的量加起来的极限，几何上是曲线下的面积。
kInt.en: The limit of adding up many tiny pieces; geometrically, the area under a curve.

kVec.zh: 一串数就是一个向量；两个向量的点积 a\cdot b=\sum_i a_i b_i 衡量它们有多“同向”。
kVec.en: A list of numbers is a vector; the dot product a\cdot b=\sum_i a_i b_i measures how much two vectors point the same way.

kMat.zh: (AB)_{ij}=\sum_k A_{ik}B_{kj}：第 i 行和第 j 列做点积。
kMat.en: (AB)_{ij}=\sum_k A_{ik}B_{kj}: the dot product of row i with column j.

kDet.zh: 2×2 矩阵把单位正方形变成平行四边形，面积乘上 |\det A|=|ad-bc|。
kDet.en: A 2×2 matrix turns the unit square into a parallelogram whose area is multiplied by |\det A|=|ad-bc|.

kJac.zh: 向量函数的所有偏导排成的矩阵 J_{ij}=\partial y_i/\partial x_j；梯度往回传时要乘它的转置。
kJac.en: The matrix of all partial derivatives of a vector function, J_{ij}=\partial y_i/\partial x_j; gradients flow back through its transpose.

kProb.zh: 每种结果一个概率，全部加起来等于 1；期望 \mathbb{E}[X]=\sum_x x\,p(x) 是按概率加权的平均。
kProb.en: One probability per outcome, summing to 1; the expectation \mathbb{E}[X]=\sum_x x\,p(x) is the probability-weighted average.

kBayes.zh: P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A)\,P(A)}{P(B)}：看到证据 B 之后，A 的可能性怎样更新。
kBayes.en: P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A)\,P(A)}{P(B)}: how the probability of A updates after seeing evidence B.

kSoft.zh: 把任意一组分数 z 变成概率：p_i=e^{z_i}/\sum_j e^{z_j}。
kSoft.en: Turns any scores z into probabilities: p_i=e^{z_i}/\sum_j e^{z_j}.

kEnt.zh: 熵 H(p)=-\sum p\log p 衡量不确定性；交叉熵 H(p,q)=-\sum p\log q 衡量“用 q 去猜 p”有多差。
kEnt.en: Entropy H(p)=-\sum p\log p measures uncertainty; cross-entropy H(p,q)=-\sum p\log q measures how badly q predicts p.

kKL.zh: \mathrm{KL}(p\Vert q)=\sum p\log\frac{p}{q}：两个分布差多远，永远 ≥ 0，相等时为 0。
kKL.en: \mathrm{KL}(p\Vert q)=\sum p\log\frac{p}{q}: how far apart two distributions are; always ≥ 0, and 0 only when they are equal.

kGD.zh: 反复执行 \theta\leftarrow\theta-\eta\,\nabla L(\theta)，一步步让损失变小。
kGD.en: Repeat \theta\leftarrow\theta-\eta\,\nabla L(\theta) to lower the loss step by step.

kLR.zh: 步长 \eta 太小走得慢，太大会来回震荡甚至发散。
kLR.en: With too small a step \eta progress is slow; too large and it oscillates or diverges.

kSGD.zh: 每步只用一小批样本估计梯度，而不是全部数据。
kSGD.en: Each step estimates the gradient from a small batch of examples instead of all the data.

kAdam.zh: 动量把过去的梯度累积起来；Adam 再按每个参数梯度的大小自动调步长。
kAdam.en: Momentum accumulates past gradients; Adam also scales each parameter’s step by the size of its gradients.

kBP.zh: 把链式法则按层倒着用，一次反向计算就得到所有参数的梯度。
kBP.en: Apply the chain rule layer by layer backwards; one backward pass gives every parameter’s gradient.

kSCE.zh: 对分数 z 的梯度就是“预测概率 − 正确答案”：\nabla_z L=p-y。
kSCE.en: The gradient with respect to the scores z is “predicted probabilities − correct answer”: \nabla_z L=p-y.

kSqrt.zh: 打分除以 \sqrt{d_k}，让点积的方差回到 1，softmax 不至于饱和。
kSqrt.en: Dividing the scores by \sqrt{d_k} brings the dot product’s variance back to 1, so softmax does not saturate.

kRes.zh: y=x+F(x) 的雅可比是 I+\partial F/\partial x，梯度总有一条“直通”的路。
kRes.en: The Jacobian of y=x+F(x) is I+\partial F/\partial x, so the gradient always has a straight-through path.

kPG.zh: \nabla_\theta J=\mathbb{E}\big[R\,\nabla_\theta\log\pi_\theta(\tau)\big]：奖励高的输出，提高它的概率。
kPG.en: \nabla_\theta J=\mathbb{E}\big[R\,\nabla_\theta\log\pi_\theta(\tau)\big]: raise the probability of outputs that earned high reward.

xreason.zh: 回答前先生成一段“草稿式”的思考（思维链），再给最终答案；多花推理时的计算换更高的正确率。
xreason.en: Before answering, the model writes a draft-like chain of thought and then the final answer: spending more compute at inference time to get more answers right.

xhalluc.zh: 模型说出流畅、像真的、但其实错误或编造的内容。
xhalluc.en: The model says something fluent and plausible that is actually wrong or made up.

xicl.zh: 不改参数，只在提示词里放几个“输入→输出”例子，模型就能照着做新任务。
xicl.en: Without changing any parameters, put a few input→output examples in the prompt and the model follows the pattern on a new task.

xstruct.zh: 让模型的输出严格符合某种格式（比如一段合法 JSON），程序才能直接读。
xstruct.en: Makes the model’s output follow a format exactly (such as valid JSON) so a program can read it directly.

xrerank.zh: 先用嵌入向量快速捞出一批候选（召回），再用更精细的模型给候选重新排序，最后把最相关的几段交给大模型并标注出处。
xrerank.en: First fetch a batch of candidates quickly with embeddings (recall), then reorder them with a finer model (rerank), and finally give the top few to the LLM with their sources.

xpar.zh: 把一次训练拆到成百上千张卡上：拆数据、拆每一层、拆层的顺序、拆专家。
xpar.en: Splits one training run over hundreds or thousands of accelerators: split the data, split each layer, split the sequence of layers, split the experts.

xdata.zh: 把原始网页变成能用来训练的语料：抽正文、去重、过滤、配比，必要时再补合成数据。
xdata.en: Turns raw web pages into training text: extract, deduplicate, filter, mix, and add synthetic data where needed.

xagentrl.zh: 让模型在真实的任务环境里自己动手（调工具、改代码），按任务是否完成给奖励，越练越会干活。
xagentrl.en: Lets the model act in a real task environment (calling tools, editing code) and rewards it for finishing the task, so it gets better at getting work done.

xsafety.zh: 在模型这一侧训练出“拒绝有害请求、但不过度拒绝”的行为，并主动找它的漏洞。
xsafety.en: Trains the model itself to refuse harmful requests without over-refusing, and actively hunts for its weak spots.

xeval.zh: 用固定的题库给模型打分，比较不同模型；但分数可能被“见过考题”抬高。
xeval.en: Scores models on fixed question sets to compare them; but scores can be inflated if the model has seen the questions.

xscale.zh: 经验规律：模型越大、数据越多、算力越多，损失按幂律平稳下降，可以提前预测。
xscale.en: An empirical rule: as model size, data and compute grow, the loss falls smoothly as a power law, so it can be predicted in advance.

xreg.zh: 防止模型把训练数据“背下来”（过拟合），让它在没见过的数据上也好用。
xreg.en: Stops the model memorising its training data (overfitting) so it also works on data it has not seen.

xvoice.zh: 让 AI 像打电话一样实时对话：能边听边说、被打断、听出语气。
xvoice.en: Lets an AI hold a phone-like conversation in real time: listen while speaking, be interrupted, hear tone of voice.

xdoc.zh: 让模型读懂发票、PDF、表格和屏幕截图：不只认字，还要知道哪是标题、哪是表头、哪是按钮。
xdoc.en: Lets a model read invoices, PDFs, tables and screenshots: not just the characters, but which part is a title, a header or a button.

xedit.zh: 按一句话改图（“把天空换成晚霞”），以及看懂一段视频在发生什么。
xedit.en: Edits an image from one sentence (“make the sky a sunset”), and understands what is happening in a video.

xcomply.zh: 用 AI 生成和发布内容时要守的规则：训练数据和输出的版权、个人信息保护、给 AI 生成内容加标识。
xcomply.en: The rules for generating and publishing with AI: copyright in training data and outputs, personal-information protection, and labelling AI-generated content.

xpool.zh: 卷积网络里把特征图“缩小、保留最强信号”的一步；层层叠起来，网络从边缘看到纹理、部件，再到整个物体。
xpool.en: The step in a convolutional network that shrinks a feature map while keeping the strongest signals; stacked up, the network goes from edges to textures, parts and whole objects.

xgen.zh: 今天图像生成模型的“前传”：学会把数据压缩成少量数字，或者学会凭空造出像真的一样的样本。
xgen.en: The prequel to today’s image generators: learn to compress data into a few numbers, or learn to produce samples that look real.

xinterp.zh: 回答“模型内部到底学到了什么”：从中间层的数字里读出概念。
xinterp.en: Answers “what has the model actually learned inside?” by reading concepts out of the numbers in its middle layers.

xssm.zh: Transformer 之外正在探索的序列模型：想在长文本上更省、更快，或者换一种生成方式。
xssm.en: Sequence models being explored beyond the Transformer: cheaper and faster on long text, or generating in a different way.

xprec.zh: 让训练和推理更快、更省显存的两类底层技巧：用更短的数字算，和更聪明地搬数据。
xprec.en: Two low-level tricks that make training and inference faster and lighter on memory: compute with shorter numbers, and move data more cleverly.

xa2a.zh: 让不同团队、不同框架做的 Agent 互相发现、分派任务、交回结果。
xa2a.en: Lets agents built by different teams and frameworks discover each other, delegate tasks and return results.
